; Ink Diary for Claude — notebook button (reMarkable Paper Pro, software 3.29.1.0).
; DocumentView selector from rmitchellscott/xovi-qmd-extensions (GPL-3.0-only).
; The hashes are /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml and FocusScope#root, the
; same spot the Paper Pro port in howardpchen/remarkable-chatgpt patches on 3.28 (GPL-3.0).
; TO CONFIRM in Stage 1 with the tablet's name map: these names, plus the notebook's own
; `toolbar` and `zoomButton` ids, still exist on 3.29.1.0 (tools/paper-pro/check-hashtab.py).
AFFECT [[1224665461898798997]]
    IMPORT QtQuick 2.15
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0
    TRAVERSE [[8397993708429497603]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Rectangle {
                id: inkDiaryControl
                objectName: "inkDiaryControl"
                z: 10000
                // 72 x 72 button at the right edge, 160 px up from the bottom so it clears
                // the toolbar if that is moved to the bottom (112 px). src/layout.h masks
                // this rect (and the Send button's) out of the page capture: keep in step.
                // TO CONFIRM in Stage 1: the spot is free of the notebook's own controls.
                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                anchors.rightMargin: 24
                anchors.bottomMargin: 160
                width: 72
                height: 72
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2
                radius: 8
                // Set by the plugin while it reads the page, so the toolbar isn't in the
                // photo. Bindings put back the notebook's own value when it is cleared.
                // `toolbar` and `zoomButton` are DocumentView ids seen on 3.28; if 3.29
                // renamed them, these stay null and the plugin says so instead of reading.
                property bool diaryHideToolbar: false
                readonly property var diaryToolbar: typeof toolbar !== "undefined" ? toolbar : null
                readonly property var diaryZoomButton: typeof zoomButton !== "undefined" ? zoomButton : null
                readonly property bool diaryToolbarFound: diaryToolbar !== null
                readonly property bool diaryToolbarHidden: diaryToolbar !== null && diaryToolbar.visible === false
                Binding {
                    target: inkDiaryControl.diaryToolbar
                    property: "visible"
                    value: false
                    when: inkDiaryControl.diaryHideToolbar && inkDiaryControl.diaryToolbar !== null
                    restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
                }
                Binding {
                    target: inkDiaryControl.diaryZoomButton
                    property: "visible"
                    value: false
                    when: inkDiaryControl.diaryHideToolbar && inkDiaryControl.diaryZoomButton !== null
                    restoreMode: Binding.RestoreBindingOrValue
                }
                // Never leave the toolbar hidden if the notebook closes mid-request.
                Component.onDestruction: diaryHideToolbar = false
                property bool diaryBusy: false
                property string diaryMessage: "Claude"
                property int diaryDrafts: 0
                property bool diaryError: false
                XoviMessageBroker { id: inkDiaryBroker }
                Image {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 52
                    height: 52
                    source: "file:///home/root/.config/ink-diary/claude.svg"
                    sourceSize.width: 52
                    sourceSize.height: 52
                    visible: !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: 30
                    height: 30
                    color: "black"
                    visible: inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                }
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.top
                    anchors.bottomMargin: 12
                    width: 520
                    height: statusText.implicitHeight + 28
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8
                    visible: (statusTimer.running || inkDiaryControl.diaryError) && !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                    Text {
                        id: statusText
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.top: parent.top
                        anchors.margins: 14
                        text: inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        color: "black"
                    }
                }
                // Send button: only while email drafts are pending. diary.cpp masks its rect out of captures.
                Rectangle {
                    anchors.right: parent.left
                    anchors.rightMargin: 16
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    width: 120
                    height: 72
                    color: "white"
                    border.color: "black"
                    border.width: 2
                    radius: 8
                    visible: inkDiaryControl.diaryDrafts > 0 && !inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy
                    Text {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: "Send " + inkDiaryControl.diaryDrafts
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        font.bold: true
                        color: "black"
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            statusTimer.stop();
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = true;
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$send", "");
                        }
                    }
                }
                Timer { id: statusTimer; interval: 5000 }
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    onPressAndHold: statusTimer.restart()
                    onClicked: {
                        statusTimer.stop();
                        if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy) {
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$cancel", "");
                        } else {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = true;
                            inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$start", "");
                        }
                    }
                }
                Timer {
                    interval: 500
                    repeat: true
                    running: inkDiaryControl.visible
                    onTriggered: {
                        try {
                            var result = JSON.parse(inkDiaryBroker.sendSimpleSignal("ink-diary$status", ""));
                            if (inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy && !result.busy) statusTimer.restart();
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = result.busy;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage = result.message;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryDrafts = result.drafts || 0;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryError = result.error === true;
                        } catch (error) {
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryBusy = false;
                            inkDiaryControl.diaryMessage = "Ink Diary extension unavailable";
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
